children: New facility aims to improve access to affordable, standardised diagnostic testing across Madurai and neighbouring regions

Thyrocare Technologies Limited has expanded its diagnostic network in Tamil Nadu with the launch of a new laboratory in Madurai, inaugurated by Rahul Guha, Managing Director and CEO, Thyrocare and API Holdings, as the company seeks to improve access to quality and affordable diagnostic services across the city and surrounding regions.

The laboratory is equipped to conduct routine and specialised diagnostic tests and is supported by trained professionals and Thyrocare’s technology-enabled processes. The facility is expected to cater to the diagnostic requirements of patients, laboratories and healthcare partners in Madurai and nearby areas.

The company said the expansion is part of its broader strategy to strengthen its presence beyond metropolitan markets and bring diagnostic services closer to patients. The laboratory will use standardised processes for sample processing and reporting, with the aim of supporting both preventive and ongoing healthcare needs.

Rahul Guha, Managing Director and CEO, Thyrocare and API Holdings, said the company’s focus has been on making trustworthy diagnostic services more accessible across India. He said the Madurai laboratory would strengthen Thyrocare’s presence in emerging markets and bring its technology-led diagnostic capabilities closer to patients.

The company has stated that all its laboratories have achieved 100% NABL accreditation, underscoring its focus on standardised quality protocols across its diagnostic network. Dr Ramesh Kinha, Chief Operating Officer, Thyrocare, said the new laboratory would strengthen the company’s ability to serve Madurai and neighbouring regions with routine and specialised testing. He added that the facility would be backed by standardised processes, technology and quality protocols to enable efficient sample processing and timely reporting.

The Madurai facility also strengthens Thyrocare’s footprint across Tamil Nadu and the wider southern region, where demand for accessible diagnostic services is growing. The company said establishing a stronger local presence would help reduce dependence on services concentrated in major metropolitan centres while enabling healthcare partners and patients to access diagnostic testing closer to their locations. With the new facility, Thyrocare continues its expansion across emerging markets, focusing on affordability, accessibility and standardised diagnostic services as part of its wider healthcare network strategy.
